name: Same-job overlap check in verify
summary: A verify check (EP-ROLE-CONFLICT) that reports installed skills, plugins or rule sets competing for one job, third-party ones included, and one component installed through two channels. It reports and never removes anything. Costs verify time only.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11647 (One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents)
evidence.setting: Co-installed skills competing for one job; measures the problem this check reports, not the check
evidence.effect: One skill took over in 1 of 5 runs

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25064 (One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix)
evidence.setting: Competing skill instructions; measures the problem this check reports, not the check

revisit: agents rank or dedupe skills natively
maintenance: Owned engine check, maintained with the engine.
